title: Best OpenClaw Alternatives in 2026 — 7 Options Tested and Ranked
summary: Looking for OpenClaw alternatives? From NanoClaw to ZeroClaw to managed hosting, here are the 7 best options — with real screenshots and honest tradeoffs.
body_markdown: The numbers look similar on the surface but the pricing models are completely different. Blink Claw charges from about $45/month per agent for the machine, and AI model usage (13 AI models) is billed from your workspace credits on top — no separate API keys or provider accounts. Clawctl charges $49/mo for the platform only — you bring your own API keys and pay Anthropic/OpenAI/Google directly on top. Typical LLM usage adds $20-80/mo depending on how heavily you use the agent. So the real Clawctl cost for most users is $70-130+/mo. Clawctl's advantage isn't price — it's compliance features like full audit trails and encrypted secrets management.
